title.en: Amending Presidential Decree No. 1663 Reconstituting the Municipalities of Panamao (Old) and New Panamao as Well as Talipao in the Province of Sulu and Changing the Name of New Panamao to Panglima Estino

text.en:
Barangays Marsada, Paiksa and Likba, all in the municipality of old Panamao and Barangay
Jinggan in the municipality of Talipao are hereby detached and separated therefrom, and included among the
barangays transferred to the Municipality of New Panamao, province of Sulu under Presidential Decree No.
1663.

Henceforth, the Municipality of New Panamao, Province of Sulu shall, as political subdivision,
be known as "Municipality of Panglimao Estino and all transactions, documents, laws, decrees, court orders,
or decisions, ordinances, resolutions, and all other papers bearing the name of New Panamao, Sulu, shall be
understood to mean "Municipality of Panglima Estino".

The present elective officials of the barangays covered in Section 1 hereof shall continue to
perform their duties as such officials until their successors shall have been elected in the regular elections for
Barangay officials following the issuance of this Decree and shall have qualified.

All laws, decrees, executive orders, ordinances, rules and regulations, or parts thereof,
inconsistent herewith are hereby repealed, amended or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
